mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_trn_paid_holiday_request ( paid_holiday_request_id, holiday_type, holiday, employee_id, request_reason, request_flag ) VALUES ( #{paidHolidayRequestId}, #{holidayType}, #{holiday}, #{employeeId}, #{requestReason}, #{requestFlag} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_trn_paid_holiday_request WHERE request_flag = #{requestFlag}

SELECT request.paid_holiday_request_id, employee.employee_id, employee.employee_name, CASE employee.department_id WHEN 1 THEN '営業部' WHEN 2 THEN '総務部' WHEN 3 THEN '人事部' ELSE '' END AS department_name, request.holiday_type, request.holiday, request.request_reason FROM tb_trn_paid_holiday_request request INNER JOIN tb_mst_employee employee ON request.employee_id = employee.employee_id WHERE request.request_flag = #{requestFlag} ORDER BY request.holiday ASC, employee.employee_id ASC, request.paid_holiday_request_id ASC

SELECT paid_holiday_request_id, holiday_type, holiday, employee_id, request_reason, request_flag FROM tb_trn_paid_holiday_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND holiday BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND request_flag IN (1, 2) ORDER BY holiday ASC, request_flag DESC, paid_holiday_request_id ASC

SELECT paid_holiday_request_id, holiday_type, holiday, employee_id, request_reason, request_flag FROM tb_trn_paid_holiday_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND request_flag = 1 ORDER BY holiday ASC, paid_holiday_request_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_trn_paid_holiday_request SET request_flag = 3 WHERE paid_holiday_request_id = #{requestId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND request_flag = 1
